title: Cloud Computing & Virtualisation
summary: AWS, Azure and GCP management, cloud migration, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) and cloud backup solutions.
problems: Ageing on-premise systems are costly to maintain and hard to scale

value: Infrastructure that scales with the business
